pass_criteria: soft cloud/nebula structure filling the frame (no hard edges)
dark purple/violet palette, dark overall (background-grade luminance)
evolution between t1 and t4 (structure moved/morphed)
subtle grain visible on close inspection

prior_iterations.critique: The palette is violet, but the result is far too bright and saturated for a dark background-grade nebula, especially at t4 where most of the frame becomes electric purple. The cloud field has a clearly visible rectangular emitter boundary across the upper area and at the side edges, which breaks the no-hard-edges requirement. Within that rectangle the image is largely smooth and uniform rather than showing layered, cloud-like nebula structure; grain is only barely perceptible. Between t1 and t4 there is substantial overall brightening, but little readable internal morphing or drifting structure.
